state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`: stage 5 (Install and Guides) is in progress. Install is done, the Tour is done, and `--check guides` is written.**

Install has four pages under `install/`, snippets under `website/snippets/install/`. Novis has no release yet, so the install page builds from source.

The Tour is `guides/tour/index.mdx` and ten steps, `01-methods-and-types.mdx` to `10-web-app.mdx`, all in the sidebar. It builds a task list: arrays, objects, null, errors, enums and match, JSON, tests, html literals, and `nvs serve`. Each step ends with a "Next:" link. Novis has no free functions (`E0215`), so every snippet uses a class. A compile error or `nvs test` output is shown as a `txt` block copied from a real run.

`--check guides` is `guidesProblems` in `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts`, with its tests in `tools/nv/test/site.test.ts`. `GUIDE_SECTIONS` fixes the eight section directories under `guides/`: `why-novis`, `tour`, `simple-programs`, `how-to-use`, `cookbook`, `testing`, `production`, `example-apps`. It checks each has pages beside its `index.mdx` (6 Simple programs, 10 Cookbook), a `<Snippet>` on every Simple program and Cookbook page, and the sidebar links in that order. It fails now on the seven sections not written yet.

The snippet runner passes `--request <name>.nvsr` when a `.nvsr` sits beside a snippet, as examples do. The Tour's last step uses it.

`site structure`, `stale`, `reference`, `syntax` and `--build` pass. `snippets` and `prose` fail only on `index.mdx`, `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx`, which stage 6 rewrites. `apps` and `in-depth` are stubs (`LATER` in `site.ts`).

items.text: **Why people pick Novis**: `guides/why-novis/index.mdx` and 10 to 14 candidate pages, one standout feature each (html literals that escape, tainted input, request isolation, typed JSON, no null surprises, tests in code, ...), each with a snippet and a link into Syntax or Reference. Draft from `website/src/content/claims/*.md`. Add the group to the sidebar before the Tour. Specified by `docs/agent/goals/side/website-overhaul.md` § Stage 5. **Simple programs**: `guides/simple-programs/` with six one-file programs (CSV report, JSON API, file watcher, scraper, form handler, scheduled job), each one snippet with its output. **Cookbook**: `guides/cookbook/` with ten task pages, one snippet each. Specified by the same section. Anchors: `website/astro.config.ts:121`
